title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E22 — Nine Hours
Hit men kidnap a child to force Banner to cooperate in their killing of a hospitalized mob witness.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E23 — On the Line
Firefighters suspect Banner of starting a forest blaze; guest Kathleen Lloyd.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 — Deadly Knightshade
Michael and KITT chase an elusive magician (Lance Burton) who may be after Devon; with Hurd Hatfield.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S4 E16 — Redemption of a Champion
A deaf sportswriter is murdered after calling Devon with his concerns over the welfare of a contender in an upcoming prizefight.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E6 — Brushfire
A canyon fire threatens the residents of a housing development and keeps the paramedics on round-the-clock duty; guest Tony Dow.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E7 — Dealer's Wild
DeSoto and Gage talk down an airplane flown by a teenage boy whose father, the pilot, suffered a heart attack while at the controls.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E8 — Nurses Wild
The paramedics hold a demonstration for student nurses, one of whom interests Gage; the hospital staff saves a robber and his victim.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E9 — Publicity Hound
Gage resents media attention given to a paramedic (Gary Crosby) from another squad; Brackett clashes with a tycoon over a diagnosis.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E10 — Weird Wednesday
The paramedics and hospital staff deal with a stubborn elderly woman (Jeanette Nolan), a parachutist in a tree and other odd cases.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E11 — Dilemma
Gage and DeSoto rescue an elderly couple from an elevator crash; Brackett berates a forgetful student nurse; a girl irritates Gage.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E12 — Hangup
Gage begins to think a television police show is real; the emergency team at Rampart Hospital treats a doctor for radiation poisoning.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E13 — Crash
Gage and DeSoto rescue a family from the wreck of a private airplane; Early and McCall treat a 4-year-old boy who has swallowed pills.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E1 — Problem
DeSoto is forced to give medical treatment without authorization when the radio link to the hospital is broken; guest Lloyd Bochner.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E2 — Kids
Brackett insists an injured boy is a child-abuse victim; the paramedics aid a trapped boy and a fallen hiker; guest Richard Jaeckel.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E3 — The Only Church in Town
Face's former girlfriend (Markie Post), now a nun, hires the team to rescue nuns and orphans held in an Ecuadorean monastery.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E4 — Bad Time on the Border
A lost Mexican girl leads B.A. to a smuggling ring responsible for illegally transporting aliens across the border.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E5 — When You Comin' Back, Range Rider?
An Indian boy wants to stop a wealthy rancher (Morgan Woodward) rustling mustangs on an Arizona reservation.
